scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>fs.promises.mkdir('dist',{recursive:true}).then(()=>Promise.all(['index.html','src/main.js','src/styles.css'].map(async f=>{const path=await import('path'); await fs.promises.mkdir(path.dirname('dist/'+f),{recursive:true}); await fs.promises.copyFile(f,'dist/'+f)}))))"
